# CONFORMANCE

The conformance ID register. Every test name ends in its ID; a test whose
ID is not listed here fails `cargo xtask check-model`, and so does an ID
listed here with no scenario and no test (`CM-02`).

The three honesty levels (R2):

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `some-true` | A fact reproduced from an authority. **Not established here.** |
| `build` | Constructed here and validated against its oracle. Evidence, not a proof. |
| `open` | Measured and reported. **Never asserted.** |

`cargo xtask audit-limits` fails if a shipped crate returns `Result` over an
error type not registered for it in `model/failures.toml`, if a registered type
is not a closed enum whose variants are exactly its rows, or if the crate does
not forbid `unwrap`, `expect` and `panic!` (R5).

| `KN-40` | `build` | One link of a row's exact recombination is confirmed exactly when the partial before it plus its up to six terms, each a unit sum times a scale mantissa times a power of two, signed, equals the claimed partial after it; a link whose numbers could pass 64 bits is too wide, and two confirmed links compose, so a chain of them confirms the plain sum |
| `KN-41` | `build` | Up to five inputs of one group are confirmed put on sixteen-bit codes exactly when the group's power of two is the largest that keeps its largest input within 32767, and each code is its input at that power rounded to the nearest, ties to even, so within half a step of it; an input far below the step is code zero |
| `KN-43` | `build` | A claimed integer square root of a value below 2^62 is confirmed exactly when its square is at most the value and the next square is above it, so a norm divides by the value's one floor root |
| `KN-44` | `build` | A claimed quotient of a value below 2^62 by a divisor below 2^31, rounded half to even to a code of at most 32767, is confirmed exactly when it passes KN-41's rounding rule with the divisor as the step, so a norm and a softmax divide by one rule |
| `KN-45` | `build` | The engine session is a pure step over open, admit a page, prompt chunk, generate and close, ready to be the guest's root in the session world: a page not named by BLAKE3 fails the session, the session is ready only when the page admitted is the manifest's last, prompt chunks compose, a generate request with a floating-point stage fails the session, the position never passes the capacity, and an ended session stays ended |
| `KN-37` | `build` | One group's sum times its IEEE half scale is confirmed exact exactly when the claimed sign and magnitude, in units of 2^-24, equal the product the kernel recomputes from the half's exponent and fraction, a zero product is never negative, and a scale that is an infinity or a NaN is answered not finite |
| `KN-42` | `build` | A claimed binary32 is confirmed exact exactly when it is the bits the kernel rounds magnitude times 2 to the exponent to: the nearest, ties to even, from the leading bit, 24 bits or fewer below the normal range, infinity past the largest finite value, and zero for a zero magnitude |

## Cited authorities

Never re-derived, vendored, or gated on.

| Authority | Citation | Evidence here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BLAKE3` | BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3, test_vectors/test_vectors.json at commit ae3e8e6b3a5ae3190ca5d62820789b17886a0038 (2020-09-29), vendored at model/authorities/blake3-test-vectors.json. The algorithm is specified in `BLAKE3: one function, fast everywhere` (O'Connor, Aumasson, Neves, Wilcox-O'Hearn, 2020). | `EN-06` |
| `GGUF` | ggml-org/ggml, docs/gguf.md. The header layout read here is its `gguf_header_t` and `gguf_metadata_kv_t`: the magic `GGUF`, a little-endian version, the tensor and metadata counts, then a key, a value type and a value for each entry. The tokeniser keys are its `tokenizer.ggml.model`, `.pre`, `.tokens`, `.merges` and `.token_type`, whose values are the format's own GGUFTokenType enumeration: 1 normal, 2 unknown, 3 control, 4 user-defined, 5 unused, 6 byte. | `EN-21` |
| `LLAMA-CPP-PRE` | ggml-org/llama.cpp, src/llama-vocab.cpp at blob e90f1bd117d412a3fc9672ddd10c5d12ded0beb2, the `regex_exprs` of LLAMA_VOCAB_PRE_TYPE_GPT2 and LLAMA_VOCAB_PRE_TYPE_QWEN2 and the names mapped to each. A GGUF file carries `tokenizer.ggml.pre` as a name only; the pattern it stands for lives in the reader. | `EN-21`, `EN-22` |
| `SHA-256` | NIST FIPS 180-4, `Secure Hash Standard`, August 2015, Appendix B: the one-block message `abc`, the two-block message `abcdbcde...nopq`, and the message of one million `a`, each with its digest. The implementation is the `sha2` crate, a locked crates.io release (R6). | `EN-24` |
| `HOLK-BONSAI` | HOLOGRAMTECH/q-ternary-bonsai-1.7b on huggingface.co at revision c6d6a12384ecc52ae7e006bef263bfedf5e7496c, the file q-ternary-bonsai-1.7b.v1.holo, bytes 0 to 98,313, vendored at model/authorities/holk-bonsai-header.bin. The file itself is 424,013,749 bytes and is not vendored; these are the bytes a reader has to get right before it can ask for any of the rest. | `EN-25` |
| `QWEN25-GGUF` | Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF on huggingface.co at revision 91cad51, the file qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf, bytes 0 to 5,950,495, vendored at model/authorities/qwen25-header.bin. The whole file is 1,066,227,232 bytes with sha256 dcd819ff094852c38faba6873d8ff0c9d51eadb2844539e52042ae5d647bbfdb, which is the digest the hub publishes for it and the digest of the copy these bytes were cut from; the file itself is not vendored. | `EN-21`, `EN-22`, `EN-27` |
| `UOR-MATMUL` | UOR-Foundation/uor-matmul, the crates uor-matmul, uor-matmul-core and uor-matmul-codec 0.1.0 as published on crates.io (2026-08-14), Apache-2.0. Its `dot_ref` sums products of `i8` values in an `i128` accumulator, wide enough for every length a machine can address, and its `Grid` codec decodes a code through a table. | `EN-34` |
| `HUB-CLIENT` | Hologram-Technologies/hub at commit ec26789fe4a7f936abd0f0c207b9e1a556d8c33c: web/hub-client.mjs and web/sigstore.mjs, vendored byte for byte at site/app/engine/hub/, and the trust policy of the hub's Prism model, screen 3 trust.policy in app/tools/site_spec.py, pinned at site/app/engine/hub/policy.json. site/app/engine/hub/VENDOR.md names each file's BLAKE3. | `GP-27` |
